title: Japanese-Style Agedashi Tofu
description: Crispy fried tofu in a savory broth, a classic Japanese comfort food.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Dredge the tofu cubes in the cornstarch mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the tofu cubes until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the tofu from the oil and drain on paper towels.
In a separate pot, combine the soy sauce, mirin, sake, kombu, and katsuobushi.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 5 minutes.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot.
Add the fried tofu to the broth and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with green onions and grated daikon.
